//exclude: Scoped to what Next actually compiles. `include` is **/*.ts, so the dev
server's background typechecker was walking 269 test files, 6 scripts and
5 scrapers on startup and on every edit — none of which Next ever bundles.
These files are STILL TYPECHECKED, by tsconfig.test.json via `npm run
typecheck`. Dropping them from the gate would be a real loss: `npm run
test` runs tsx, which strips types without checking them, so a type error
in a test would otherwise reach nobody.
